mentions.title: N55 rod bearings recommendation
mentions.snippet: In a rod-bearing recommendation thread, one poster reports King brand rod bearings on an N54 leading to complete engine seizure. Single account inside an otherwise neutral thread.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: King main thrust bearings produced since 2024 are reported out of spec, with a tech rep quoted as saying they would not personally use them. Poster reports thrust bearings slipping onto grooves too easily, raising spin risk.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports receiving in-spec NOS Clevite thrust bearings.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Defect report: a King SI main bearing described as malformed in production, crushed and twisted and badly out of size, plus machining shavings on the rod bearings requiring extensive hand cleaning.
